title: M6 existing recovery frame allocation and complete address capacity
scope: Clarifies the accepted fixed indexed-array budget only. No compiler-stack, codegen, timing or stronger asymptotic target is introduced. The current trace output is already included in actualTraceStorage; two extra coefficient buffers plus full conservative recovery frames fit the unchanged pairedQueryStorage.

spec.name: M6.Transfer.recovery_stack_allocation
spec.statement: ∀ R N : ℕ, M6.Transfer.actualTraceStorage R N + 2*(2*N+1)*M6.Transfer.queryCoefficientBits R N + M6.Transfer.recoveryStackBits R N ≤ M6.Transfer.pairedQueryStorage R N
spec.guidance: For stack allocation unfold the literal counter definitions and List.length_finRange; cancellation leaves a nonnegative polynomial (can split N=0,1,2 or bound square). The Option-bit pins use2 bits each, hence4N/frame. For full addressing apply accepted solve_storage_bound, use N<=2^N so N²<=2^(2N), 16384=2^14, and actualAddressBits=R+4N+16. Preserve original constants and indexed-array model. Return tactic lines without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Transfer.complete_address_capacity
spec.statement: ∀ R N slots : ℕ, R < N → slots ≤ 512*(N+1)^2 → M6.Transfer.solveStorage R N slots < 2^(M6.Transfer.actualAddressBits R N)
